meta.source: hand-authored ~100bb 6-max equilibrium approximations (scripts/authored-preflop.mjs) — NOT solver output
meta.notes: Per-hand mixed frequencies authored to approximate 100bb 6-max equilibrium. They are NOT a solve and must not be presented as one. Regenerate with `node scripts/authored-preflop.mjs`. Overwrite any single scenario with a real solver export via scripts/solver-to-preflop.mjs — overrides are per-scenario, so real solves and authored charts coexist. Run `node scripts/solver-to-preflop.mjs --report` for coverage. Bundled at build time: restart the dev server after editing.
